1	/**
2	 * Web question plugin, browser half: QuestionComposer registered as a
3	 * selector-routed entry of the conversation-declared composer chain, plus the
4	 * `question` dictionaries. The selector narrows the owner's currency to the
5	 * question carrier (matched prop), and the whole behavior surface rides the
6	 * carrier (domain encoding in contract/slots.ts PendingQuestion); copy rides
7	 * the standard locale seat. Export discipline: packages/client/AGENTS.md.
8	 *
9	 * One entry, two presentations: the composer renders a request with a
10	 * `plan-review` intent as the plan decision card and every other request as
11	 * the generic question flow. Both use the same carrier and composer seat.
12	 */
13	import type { Context as ClientContext } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'
14	import type {} from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-remotes/client'
15	import type { SessionId } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-session/types'
16	import type {} from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-chat/client'
17	import type { ComposerChainProps } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation/client'
18	import type {} from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-renderer/client'
19	import type { PendingInteractionPublisher } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-session/client'
20	import type { TypertClientEventListener } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-typert-protocol'
21	import type { AskUserQuestionItem, PendingUserQuestion, UserQuestionProjectionView } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-user-questions/types'
22	// Type-only: pulls the locale plugin's Context merge (ctx.locale).
23	import type {} from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale/client'
24	import type { UserQuestionPanels, UserQuestionRecord } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-tool/client'
25	import type { ToolCallId } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm'
26	import { brandString } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-brand'
27	import { createWaterfallRequest, PendingQuestion, type QuestionRpcChannel } from './contract/slots.ts'
28	import { createQuestionDraftStore } from './draft-store.ts'
29	import { QuestionComposer } from './QuestionComposer.tsx'
30	import { questionReplyDefinition } from './question-reply.ts'
31	import { QuestionReplyView } from './QuestionReplyView.tsx'
32	import { en, zh, type QuestionKey } from './locales.ts'
33	
34	export type {
35	  PendingQuestion, PlanReview, QuestionAnswer, QuestionComposerProps, QuestionWait,
36	} from './contract/slots.ts'
37	export type { QuestionKey } from './locales.ts'
38	
39	declare module '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots' {
40	  interface LocaleNamespaceMap {
41	    /** The question composer's copy. */
42	    question: QuestionKey
43	  }
44	}
45	
46	/** Dictionary namespace owned by this plugin. */
47	const NS = 'question'
48	
49	type QuestionListener = TypertClientEventListener<'user-questions/request'>
50	type ClientQuestionRequest = Parameters<QuestionListener>[0]
51	type ClientQuestionNext = Parameters<QuestionListener>[1]
52	type ClientQuestionAnswer = Awaited<ReturnType<QuestionListener>>
53	
54	/** Required services: Agent scopes, Remote Events, Session UI, Slot registry, conversation nodes, and copy. */
55	export const inject = ['sessions', 'remote', 'remote.userQuestions', 'uiSession', 'slots', 'locale', 'uiConversation']
56	
57	/** One card and the composer seat it moves in and out of. */
58	interface QuestionCard {
59	  readonly pending: PendingQuestion
60	  /** Withdraw the panel from the composer seat; the request and its countdown stand. */
61	  readonly hide: () => void
62	  /** Publish the panel last, so it wins the seat against any other pending question. */
63	  readonly reveal: () => void
64	  /** Drop the card for good: the projection no longer lists its call. */
65	  readonly remove: () => void
66	  /** Track forwarded requests through claim opening and waterfall settlement. */
67	  readonly trackRequest: (completion: Promise<void>) => () => void
68	  /** Whether the forwarded request is still opening or waiting for settlement. */
69	  readonly hasRequest: () => boolean
70	}
71	
72	/**
73	 * Cards published to the Session pending-interaction registry, keyed by
74	 * `PendingQuestion.key`. A tool-call-keyed card is shared by the forwarded
75	 * waterfall and the Session projection.
76	 *
77	 * A card outlives its seat. Closing the panel only unpublishes it, which keeps
78	 * the request answerable from its tool call row, so this registry — not the
79	 * pending-interaction registry — decides when a request is over.
80	 */
81	class QuestionCards {
82	  readonly #cards = new Map<string, QuestionCard>()
83	
84	  constructor(private readonly publish: PendingInteractionPublisher<PendingQuestion>) {}
85	
86	  byCallId(sessionId: SessionId, callId: string): QuestionCard | undefined {
87	    return this.#cards.get(PendingQuestion.keyOf(sessionId, callId))
88	  }
89	
90	  /** Observable state for one card while the registry owns it. */
91	  source(key: string): PendingQuestion | undefined {
92	    return this.#cards.get(key)?.pending
93	  }
94	
95	  values(): readonly QuestionCard[] {
96	    return [...this.#cards.values()]
97	  }
98	
99	  /** Keys of every card registered for one Session. */
100	  keysFor(sessionId: SessionId): readonly string[] {
101	    return this.values().filter(card => card.pending.sessionId === sessionId).map(card => card.pending.key)
102	  }
103	
104	  /**
105	   * Return the card of a tool call, creating and publishing it when absent.
106	   * A request without a call id always gets a fresh card.
107	   */
108	  ensure(sessionId: SessionId, questions: readonly AskUserQuestionItem[], callId: ToolCallId | undefined): QuestionCard {
109	    if (callId !== undefined) {
110	      const existing = this.byCallId(sessionId, callId)
111	      if (existing !== undefined) return existing
112	    }
113	    return this.#create(new PendingQuestion(sessionId, questions, callId, () => this.keysFor(sessionId)))
114	  }
115	
116	  /** Publish one carrier into the composer seat and register the card that owns it. */
117	  #create(pending: PendingQuestion): QuestionCard {
118	    const requests = new Set<Promise<void>>()
119	    const delegate = async (): Promise<void> => {
120	      pending.delegate()
121	      await Promise.all(requests)
122	    }
123	    // Republishing is how a revealed card reaches the seat: the registry keeps
124	    // the last entry of equal precedence, and it rejects a duplicate key.
125	    let unpublish: (() => void) | undefined = this.publish(pending, delegate)
126	    const card: QuestionCard = {
127	      pending,
128	      hide: () => {
129	        unpublish?.()
130	        unpublish = undefined
131	      },
132	      reveal: () => {
133	        unpublish?.()
134	        unpublish = this.publish(pending, delegate)
135	      },
136	      remove: () => {
137	        /* v8 ignore next -- a card leaves the registry once; no caller holds a card the registry already replaced. */
138	        if (this.#cards.get(pending.key) !== card) return
139	        this.#cards.delete(pending.key)
140	        pending.close()
141	        unpublish?.()
142	        unpublish = undefined
143	      },
144	      trackRequest: (completion) => {
145	        requests.add(completion)
146	        return () => { requests.delete(completion) }
147	      },
148	      hasRequest: () => requests.size > 0,
149	    }
150	    // A review card has no request left to park: closing it drops the card, and
151	    // the tool call row builds another one from the same transcript record.
152	    pending.attachSeat({ hide: pending.review === undefined ? card.hide : card.remove })
153	    this.#cards.set(pending.key, card)
154	    return card
155	  }
156	
157	  /**
158	   * Show the panel of one answerable tool call.
159	   * @param sessionId - Session the tool call belongs to.
160	   * @param callId - `ask_user_question` call whose panel to show, as its
161	   * transcript row spells it.
162	   * @returns whether a card for that call is still answerable.
163	   */
164	  reveal(sessionId: SessionId, callId: string): boolean {
165	    const card = this.byCallId(sessionId, callId)
166	    if (card === undefined) return false
167	    card.reveal()
168	    return true
169	  }
170	
171	  /**
172	   * Show one settled tool call's recorded answers as a read-only card. A call
173	   * that somehow still holds a card is shown as it stands, so a live request is
174	   * never replaced by a stale copy of itself.
175	   * @param sessionId - Session the tool call belongs to.
176	   * @param callId - `ask_user_question` call whose record to show, as its
177	   * transcript row spells it.
178	   * @param record - the call's questions and recorded answers.
179	   * @returns true; a record always produces a card.
180	   */
181	  review(sessionId: SessionId, callId: string, record: UserQuestionRecord): boolean {
182	    const card = this.byCallId(sessionId, callId) ?? this.#create(new PendingQuestion(
183	      sessionId,
184	      record.questions,
185	      brandString<ToolCallId>(callId),
186	      () => this.keysFor(sessionId),
187	      record.answers,
188	    ))
189	    card.reveal()
190	    return true
191	  }
192	
193	  /**
194	   * Hand every live waterfall back at plugin teardown. The pending-interaction
195	   * registry only drains what it currently holds, and a hidden card is not in
196	   * it, so its Host request would wait for its own abort instead.
197	   */
198	  dispose(): void {
199	    for (const card of this.values()) {
200	      card.pending.delegate()
201	      card.remove()
202	    }
203	  }
204	}
205	
206	/** Present one forwarded request through its card until the waterfall settles. */
207	async function answerQuestion(
208	  ctx: ClientContext,
209	  owner: ClientContext,
210	  request: ClientQuestionRequest,
211	  next: ClientQuestionNext,
212	  cards: QuestionCards,
213	): Promise<ClientQuestionAnswer> {
214	  const sessionId = ctx.sessions.scopeOf(owner)
215	  if (sessionId === undefined) return next()
216	  const callId = request.wait?.callId
217	  const card = cards.ensure(sessionId, request.questions, callId)
218	  const claimLifetime = new AbortController()
219	  const claimSignal = request.signal === undefined ? claimLifetime.signal
220	    : AbortSignal.any([claimLifetime.signal, request.signal])
221	  let claim: ReturnType<typeof ctx.remote.userQuestions.attachWait> | undefined
222	  let claimEnded: Promise<never> | undefined
223	  let delegateRequest: (() => void) | undefined
224	  const releaseClaim = request.wait?.timed === true && callId !== undefined
225	    ? ctx.effect(() => {
226	      claim = ctx.remote.userQuestions.attachWait(sessionId, callId, claimSignal)
227	      return async () => {
228	        delegateRequest?.()
229	        claimLifetime.abort()
230	        claim?.dispose()
231	        if (claimEnded !== undefined) await Promise.allSettled([claimEnded])
232	      }
233	    }, 'ui-user-questions: foreground claim')
234	    : undefined
235	  const completed = Promise.withResolvers<void>()
236	  const finishRequest = card.trackRequest(completed.promise)
237	  try {
238	    const iterator = claim?.[Symbol.asyncIterator]()
239	    const opening = iterator === undefined ? undefined : await iterator.next()
240	    if (opening?.done === true) return await next()
241	    const waterfall = createWaterfallRequest(
242	      opening === undefined ? undefined : Date.now() + opening.value.remainingMs,
243	      claimSignal,
244	      (channel) => { card.pending.detachWaterfall(channel) },
245	    )
246	    // Cancellation may win between the first claim frame and this continuation.
247	    // The request has already settled, so its channel must never reach the card.
248	    if (claimSignal.aborted) return await waterfall.result
249	    delegateRequest = () => { waterfall.channel.delegate() }
250	    card.pending.attachWaterfall(waterfall.channel)
251	    if (iterator !== undefined) {
252	      claimEnded = (async () => {
253	        await iterator.next()
254	        throw new Error('the foreground question wait ended')
255	      })()
256	    }
257	    try {
258	      return await (claimEnded === undefined ? waterfall.result : Promise.race([waterfall.result, claimEnded]))
259	    } catch (error) {
260	      if (waterfall.isDelegation(error)) {
261	        await releaseClaim?.()
262	        return await next()
263	      }
264	      throw error
265	    }
266	  } finally {
267	    if (releaseClaim === undefined) claimLifetime.abort()
268	    else if (claimEnded === undefined) await releaseClaim()
269	    else {
270	      // The Host closes the claim after accepting the waterfall outcome.
271	      // A local return precedes transmission and cannot release that claim.
272	      void Promise.allSettled([claimEnded]).then(() => { void releaseClaim() })
273	    }
274	    // A blocking request without a call id is not in the projection; its card ends with its waterfall.
275	    if (callId === undefined) card.remove()
276	    completed.resolve()
277	    finishRequest()
278	  }
279	}

281	/**
282	 * Mirror the `userQuestions` projection of every bound Session onto the cards:
283	 * continued rows get a card and the Remote answer path, and a tool-call-keyed
284	 * card whose call the projection no longer lists is removed once its waterfall is gone.
285	 */
286	function publishContinuedQuestions(ctx: ClientContext, cards: QuestionCards): () => void {
287	  const sessions = ctx.sessions
288	  const stopProjections = new Map<SessionId, () => void>()
289	
290	  const unwrap = <T>(result: { ok: true; value: T } | { ok: false; error: { message: string } }): T => {
291	    if (!result.ok) throw new Error(result.error.message)
292	    return result.value
293	  }
294	  const rpcFor = (sessionId: SessionId, callId: ToolCallId): QuestionRpcChannel => ({
295	    answer: async answer => unwrap(await ctx.remote.userQuestions.answer(sessionId, callId, answer)),
296	  })
297	
298	  const reconcile = (): void => {
299	    const snapshot = sessions.list.getSnapshot()
300	    const bound = new Map(Object.values(snapshot.byId).flatMap((summary) => {
301	      const binding = sessions.binding(summary.id)
302	      return binding === undefined ? [] : [[summary.id, binding] as const]
303	    }))
304	    for (const [sessionId, stop] of stopProjections) {
305	      if (bound.has(sessionId)) continue
306	      stop()
307	      stopProjections.delete(sessionId)
308	    }
309	    for (const [sessionId, binding] of bound) {
310	      if (stopProjections.has(sessionId)) continue
311	      stopProjections.set(sessionId, binding.session.projections.faceOf('userQuestions').subscribe(reconcile))
312	    }
313	    const rows = new Map<string, { sessionId: SessionId; row: PendingUserQuestion }>()
314	    for (const [sessionId, binding] of bound) {
315	      const projected = binding.session.projections.faceOf('userQuestions').getSnapshot() as
316	        UserQuestionProjectionView | undefined
317	      for (const row of projected?.active ?? []) {
318	        rows.set(PendingQuestion.keyOf(sessionId, row.callId), { sessionId, row })
319	      }
320	    }
321	    for (const { sessionId, row } of rows.values()) {
322	      if (row.state === 'continued') {
323	        const card = cards.ensure(sessionId, row.questions, row.callId)
324	        card.pending.attachRpc(rpcFor(sessionId, row.callId))
325	        card.pending.setState('continued')
326	        continue
327	      }
328	      cards.byCallId(sessionId, row.callId)?.pending.setState('open')
329	    }
330	    for (const card of cards.values()) {
331	      // A review card's call already settled, so the projection no longer lists it as answerable.
332	      if (card.pending.callId === undefined
333	        || card.pending.review !== undefined
334	        || rows.has(card.pending.key)
335	        || card.hasRequest()
336	        || card.pending.hasWaterfall()) continue
337	      card.remove()
338	    }
339	  }
340	
341	  reconcile()
342	  const stopList = sessions.list.subscribe(reconcile)
343	  return () => {
344	    stopList()
345	    for (const stop of stopProjections.values()) stop()
346	    stopProjections.clear()
347	  }
348	}

350	/**
351	 * Client plugin body: register the `question` dictionaries, the question
352	 * composer into the composer chain, and the late-reply conversation node.
353	 * Zero business face — data and verbs live on the matched carrier; t rides
354	 * the standard locale seat.
355	 * @param ctx - client root context.
356	 */
357	export function apply(ctx: ClientContext): void {
358	  ctx.effect(() => ctx.locale.register(NS, { zh, en }), 'ui-user-questions: dictionaries')
359	  const questionDraftStore = createQuestionDraftStore()
360	  const registerPendingInteraction = ctx.uiSession.registerPendingInteraction<PendingQuestion>(
361	    pending => pending.kind === 'plan-review' ? 2 : 1,
362	  )
363	  const cards = new QuestionCards(registerPendingInteraction)
364	  ctx.effect(() => () => { cards.dispose() }, 'ui-user-questions: cards')
365	  const disposePanels = ctx.reflect.provide('userQuestionPanels', {
366	    reveal: (sessionId, callId) => cards.reveal(sessionId, callId),
367	    review: (sessionId, callId, record) => cards.review(sessionId, callId, record),
368	  } satisfies UserQuestionPanels)
369	  ctx.effect(() => disposePanels, 'ui-user-questions: answer panels')
370	  ctx.effect(() => publishContinuedQuestions(ctx, cards), 'ui-user-questions: continued questions')
371	  ctx.slots.inject('conversation.composer', () => ctx.slots.register(
372	    {
373	      name: 'conversation.composer',
374	      select: ({ pendingInteraction }: ComposerChainProps): PendingQuestion | null =>
375	        pendingInteraction instanceof PendingQuestion ? pendingInteraction : null,
376	      locale: NS,
377	      store: questionDraftStore,
378	      inject: () => ({ keyedHooks: { questionCard: (key: string) => cards.source(key) } }),
379	      children: { 'conversation.plan-review.actions': { kind: 'list', scope: 'session' } },
380	    },
381	    QuestionComposer,
382	  ))
383	  ctx.uiConversation.events.register(questionReplyDefinition)
384	  ctx.slots.inject('conversation.chat.node', () => ctx.slots.register({
385	    name: 'conversation.chat.node',
386	    key: 'question-reply',
387	    locale: NS,
388	  }, QuestionReplyView))
389	  ctx.remote.$on('user-questions/request', function (request, next) {
390	    return answerQuestion(ctx, this, request, next, cards)
391	  })
392	}
